name: Sub dropout
desc: A round Ab-minor sine sub whose groove is defined by what's missing: a per-cycle mask punches structural dropouts and nested half-drops into the pattern so the low end stutters and gaps like a glitching sampler. A four-cycle i-VII-v-III walk alternates the harmony and a slow lpf breathes over 16 cycles. Warm, heavy, and full of holes.

code.full: note("<[ab1 ~ ab1 ab1 ~ ab1 eb2 ~] [ab1 ~ ab1 ab1 ~ ab1 gb1 ~] [eb1 ~ eb1 eb1 ~ eb1 gb1 ~] [db2 ~ ab1 ab1 ~ ab1 bb1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fast(${rate}).attack(.006).decay(.3).sustain(.35).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).room(.1).mask("<1 1 1 [1 0]>").orbit(3).play()
